steps.label: Report the founder's defeat at the Recruitment Centre.
Courage reaches rank 5 (Heroic).
Ask the Grand Cathedral guard about Neuras' relic.
Persuade Eupha that the Sanctists will listen (Follower rank 7).
Meet Alonzo in Brilehaven after reaching Courage 5 and see his final performance through (Follower rank 7).
Help Basilio stop Vinca; receive 'A Brother's Mercy' (Follower rank 7).
Take in the reopened Opera House show.
Eloquence reaches rank 5 (Rhetorician).
Harvest the Plant Culture Chamber — a Tail Bait may turn up.
Hear Eupha out (Follower rank 8).
Clear the Manor of the Ascendant; on 2F use the crawl-space route to collect its Gold Beetle before the climb, then slay the Kokamordos.
Report the Kokamordos kill.
Face Vinca with Basilio — no weaknesses, resists all physical; defeating him completes 'A Brother's Mercy' and raises Basilio to Follower rank 8.
Return to Alonzo's usual Brilehaven spot and speak with Daturam to close out the Faker bond (Follower rank 8).
Chase the stolen relics to Jin's runner; do the laundry for bonus max MP.
Steal the Fortune God's Abacus from Jin; the mercenaries are pushovers (Follower rank 8 for Neuras).
Depart for the Abandoned Path — a free day; pass the time however you like.
Clear the Abandoned Path — collect the Gold Beetle in the northern area along the left wall, then let Catherina soften the boss.
Report the final bounty request.
Purify the Crimson Split Shoes at St. Fermis Church.
Set course for the Forsaken Tower for Trial of the Dragon: Mad Mischief.
Climb to the rooftop and defeat the Devourer of Nations; Mad Mischief completes.
Ask Edeni to clear the Spire of Blind Faith's weather, then set course for the spire for Trial of the Dragon: Heroes' Rest. If the 6F Gold Beetle was missed on 8/27, collect it now.
Climb to the rooftop and defeat the Devourer of Flames; Heroes' Rest completes.

Set course for the Tower of Insolence for Trial of the Dragon: Bygone Legacy; the trip passes Decaying Estate and awards the Decaying Estate Drawing. At the tower, collect the Gold Beetle on the north side of 2F and defeat the Ziocropos on the way up for 'Proof of Power'.
Defeat the Devourer of Stars; Bygone Legacy completes and Trial of the Dragon: Essence of Power opens.
At night, report the Ziocropos to the Obsessive Soldier to complete 'Proof of Power', then soak at the Blue Sky Bridge hot spring and collect water for the Gentle Merchant.
Return the hot spring water to the Gentle Merchant at Blue Sky Bridge to complete 'Deliver Hot Spring Water' — the reward is the route's 50th and final Gold Beetle.
Optional: if you still have spare Tail Bait, fish for extra Lord of the Lake or Queen's Honey Jars; the first-playthrough recipe inventory was already secured before Sublime Spoonful.
Return to the Dragon Temple for Trial of the Dragon: Essence of Power; avoid repel gear and defeat the Elegy of the Soul.
Complete Essence of Power after the three dragon trials — Entrusted unlocks.
Warp to Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and hand all collected Gold Beetles to the Elderly Entomophile. The route has all 50; 46 are enough for every exchange reward, and All That Glitters unlocks.
At Akademeia, begin the final Special Experiment cleanup for every Masked Dancer mask and Summoner vessel — the first experiment unlocks For Science!.

For missing materials, use the Wary Shopkeep's weekday-rotating Arcana White Masks in Brilehaven and Krozelli's purchasable talismans on Virga Island; do not assume Talisman of the Divine is Skybound-only.
Begin the coliseum grind in Brilehaven.
Blight weather bars the coliseum today — use the free time for missing Special Experiment materials or other unvisited side activities.
Hear the Nostalgic Elder's story in Martira.
Ranked League — Silver I into Gold III; bring Light and Strike for the Brawler bout.
Push the Gauntlet Challenge at night.
Storm the Skybound Avatar to stop Louis — sweep every chest, the gear inside is top-tier.
Defeat the Skybound Avatar boss and complete Skybound Avatar Conquest — Skybound Hope unlocks.
The decisive battle is set for ten days from now — the rest is free time.
Audit Special Experiments and craft every remaining Masked Dancer mask and Summoner vessel; Summon Mask Time unlocks only when the full craft list is complete.
Optional NG+ stockpile: if you have spare bait, fish extra Lord of the Lake or Queen's Honey Jars. Ordinary items and cooking ingredients carry into New Game+.
Final Ranked League bout — the human resists everything but Almighty; Royal Sword synthesis ends it. Champion of the coliseum.
Take the Bullish Youth's diving competition at Brilehaven's west docks.
Hear the Nostalgic Elder finish her tale.
Build the Clumsy Man's cat-like snowman: round and paunchy, pointy headscarf.
Donate 250 reeve to the Upper Blue Sky Bridge Activist Woman — earns Fruit Cordial.
Hear the Sanctor's full tale at Brilehaven.
Chat with the Chipper Old Woman on Dia Franco Street.
Explain the mustari relic to the Masked Woman in Martira.
Camp at Lone Isle and meditate with Eupha.
Listen to Junah sing around the campfire.
Last day before the Tyrant's Star — final toilet bonus (+1 Luck) and the last round of shopping.
Visit the King's Rock one last time.
Final Pantry check, then set course for the Tyrant's Star — there is no turning back; Neuras sells consumables aboard.
For Star Shatterer, ignore every Melancholia Crystal and its optional sub-boss elevator so Destroyer Charadrius stays at full power.
Inside Akademeia, answer 'No! Magic hasn't been lost.' — the fight that follows is a formality.
Defeat full-power Destroyer Charadrius — Star Shatterer unlocks.
After the credits, the epilogue catches up with the kingdom in 'Idlesday, December 35'.
